props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: delayMs
props.description:
Delay, in milliseconds, before the fallback is shown. Useful to avoid a
flash of fallback content while a fast image loads. Defaults to `0` (show
immediately when there is no loaded image).
